controlCenter.metaDescription: See what needs you, what RADR is handling, and verified value since your last check.
controlCenter.title: Attention first. Not another inbox.
controlCenter.lead: The few things that need you. RADR handles the rest. Verified value since your last check.
controlCenter.briefLead: Exposure that still needs judgment, decisions ready for approval, and value already verified.

findings.metaDescription: Material money opportunities across BUY, LABOR, SELL and RECOVER, with evidence and a Prepared Action.
findings.title: Material money. Evidence attached.
findings.lead: Un écart opérationnel avec économie, preuves et prochaine étape préparée.
findings.anatomyLead: Every Finding carries value at stake, why RADR believes it, and a Prepared Action. Not a vague recommendation.
findings.doctrineNote: RADR prefers HANDLE → PREPARE → ASK → INFORM. Marketing never claims execution ahead of product truth.

ask.metaDescription: Ask the operation in plain language. Get evidence, money at stake, and a Prepared Action where possible.
ask.title: Ask the operation.
ask.lead: Questions sérieuses. Réponses avec preuves, économie et prochaine étape.
ask.panelTitle: Not a chatbot. An operating surface.
ask.panelLead: Questions resolve into Findings, money, and Prepared Actions, grounded in your connected systems.
ask.answerLead: Peak staffing is currently your highest priority.
ask.answerBody: At {location}, expected peak demand exceeds scheduled FOH capacity between {peakStart} and {peakEnd}.
ask.honestyNote: Ask RADR uses the same Findings and Prepared Actions as Control Center. It does not invent autonomy.

actions.metaDescription: RADR finishes investigation and preparation so operators approve with economics, evidence, and a clear default.
actions.title: Work finished before you arrive.
actions.lead: Preuves, économie, owner, statut, prêts pour votre jugement.
actions.boardLead: Each item shows what RADR already did and what still needs a human.
actions.governanceNote: Prepared for approval. External execution happens only through supported systems and organization policy.

value.metaDescription: Track identified opportunity through observed outcome. RADR only claims what the operation can prove.
value.title: Claim only what you can prove.
value.lead: Résultat économique observé. Le potentiel reste séparé jusqu’à preuve.
value.proofLead: One recovery example from the illustrative Berlin demo world.

verified.label: Verified
verified.detail: Claims observed revenue, not the estimate

value.restraint: RADR does not take credit for what it cannot prove.

forecast.metaDescription: See expected demand, revenue and margin, then open the live forecast surface in the Control Center demo.
forecast.title: Know what is coming.
forecast.lead: Baseline demand and the drivers that move it. Open the demo forecast to see how RADR reads the week ahead. Illustrative data, not live predictions for your venues.
forecast.boardLead: Three operating gaps RADR watches as the week unfolds.
forecast.demoNote: The forecast demo uses illustrative data. It does not claim autonomous execution.
